name: Himenomiya Kana
source: The oldest Himenomiya sister. She's the first to rape her brother because she refuses to let her sisters beat her. Although she's not as good a cook as Alice she's the sister most qualified to become a housewife. She becomes very jealous over Takeya, even over her own sisters.
